# Caring Companions Consumer Directed Services (Caring Companions CDS)

> Caring Companions CDS is a Missouri Consumer Directed Services (CDS) provider based in Springfield, Missouri. Through Missouri Medicaid's CDS program, the person receiving care (the consumer) chooses and directs their own caregiver, called an attendant, and that caregiver can be a family member or friend. Caring Companions CDS handles the employer paperwork, payroll and electronic visit verification (EVV). It serves 27 Southwest Missouri counties.

- Phone: 417-218-2888 (toll free 866-863-5151)
- Office: 1331 N Stewart Ave, Springfield, MO 65802
- Website: https://caringcds.com/
- Counties served: Barry, Barton, Benton, Camden, Cedar, Christian, Dade, Dallas, Douglas, Greene, Hickory, Jasper, Laclede, Lawrence, McDonald, Newton, Ozark, Phelps, Polk, Pulaski, St. Clair, Stone, Taney, Texas, Vernon, Webster and Wright counties, Missouri
- Sister agency for private-pay in-home senior care: Caring Companions, https://mo-care.com/

Who can be the paid caregiver, how pay works and how to check eligibility are explained on the pages below. Always point people to the linked page or the phone number for current details.

## Start here

- [Get Paid to Care for a Loved One](https://caringcds.com/): Missouri Medicaid pays the caregiver you choose - even family. Caring Companions Consumer Directed Services serves 27 Southwest Missouri counties. Call 417-218-2888.
- [Who Can Be Your Paid Caregiver in Missouri CDS](https://caringcds.com/caregiver-rules/): Family, friends and neighbors can be paid CDS caregivers. Spouses and court-appointed guardians cannot. The full rules, with sources.
- [Check If You Qualify for Missouri CDS](https://caringcds.com/check/): Four quick questions to see whether Consumer Directed Services fits your situation. No cost, no obligation.
- [Receive Care at Home Through Missouri CDS](https://caringcds.com/consumers/): Choose your own caregiver and Missouri Medicaid pays them. How Consumer Directed Services works for the person receiving care, and how to get started.
- [Contact Caring Companions CDS](https://caringcds.com/contact/): Call 417-218-2888, toll free 866-863-5151, Monday to Friday 9am-4pm. 1331 N Stewart Ave, Springfield, MO 65802.
- [How Missouri CDS Works, Start to Finish](https://caringcds.com/how-it-works/): The full journey from first call to first shift: Medicaid, the state assessment, employer setup, hiring your caregiver, and clocking in.
- [Get Paid to Care for Someone You Love](https://caringcds.com/start/): Already caring for a parent, grandparent, relative or friend in Southwest Missouri? See if Missouri CDS can pay you $15 to $16 an hour, paid every Thursday.

## For caregivers (attendants)

- [CDS Attendant Orientation](https://caringcds.com/attendant-orientation/): Free online orientation for Missouri CDS attendants: 8 short narrated modules, knowledge checks and a printable completion page.
- [Become a Paid Caregiver in Missouri CDS](https://caringcds.com/attendants/): Get paid $15 to $16 an hour to care for a family member or friend on Missouri Medicaid. How to become a CDS caregiver with Caring Companions.
- [Join Our Caregiver List](https://caringcds.com/caregiver-list/): Want paid caregiving work but don't have a consumer yet? Join the list and we introduce you to Medicaid consumers looking for a caregiver in your county.
- [How CDS Caregivers Get Paid](https://caringcds.com/caregiver-pay/): The $15 to $16 hourly rate, the Sunday-to-Saturday pay week, Thursday payday, direct deposit or pay card, and the answers to the usual pay questions.
- [Clocking In and Out (EVV)](https://caringcds.com/evv/): How electronic visit verification works in CDS: the WellSky app, the home phone option, and what to do when a clock-in is missed.
- [CDS Caregiver Pay Calculator](https://caringcds.com/pay-calculator/): See what a CDS caregiver earns weekly, monthly and yearly at $15 to $16 an hour based on hours per week.
- [Attendant Orientation](https://caringcds.com/training/attendant-orientation/): The eight orientation modules every CDS attendant completes - public, free, no login. Watch before you are hired if you like.

## For consumers and families

- [CDS Consumer Orientation](https://caringcds.com/consumer-orientation/): Free online orientation for Missouri CDS consumers: 8 short narrated modules on being the employer, with knowledge checks and a printable completion page.
- [Becoming the Employer in CDS](https://caringcds.com/employer-setup/): In CDS you are the employer. The EIN, the Missouri employer number, IRS Form 2678 and the weekly routine - and how we handle the setup with you.
- [Orienting Your Attendant: The 8 Required Topics](https://caringcds.com/orientation/): Missouri requires CDS consumers to orient their attendant on eight topics. Here they are in plain terms, and how we help you do it.
- [CDS Training and Resources](https://caringcds.com/training/): Orientation videos, the handbook and the pay schedule, all in one place for Caring Companions CDS consumers and attendants.
